description: This file implements thread synchronization primitives and thread-local storage management for Windows in the BoringSSL cryptography library.

methods.name: call_once_init
methods.description: Callback function for one-time initialization using InitOnceExecuteOnce.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_init
methods.description: Initializes a CRYPTO_MUTEX with a Windows SRWLOCK.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_lock_read
methods.description: Acquires a read lock on a CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_lock_write
methods.description: Acquires a write lock on a CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_unlock_read
methods.description: Releases a read lock on a CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_unlock_write
methods.description: Releases a write lock on a CRYPTO_MUTEX.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up a CRYPTO_MUTEX (no-op for SRWLOCK).

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_lock_read
methods.description: Locks a static mutex for reading.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_lock_write
methods.description: Locks a static mutex for writing.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_unlock_read
methods.description: Unlocks a static mutex from reading.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_unlock_write
methods.description: Unlocks a static mutex from writing.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_thread_local
methods.description: Gets a thread-local data pointer by index.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_thread_local
methods.description: Sets a thread-local data pointer with a destructor.
